content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the Alcor driver writing data before the associated MMC command had completed. This premature data writing was occurring because the driver was attempting to handle data transfer and command submission simultaneously. As a result, the hardware occasionally signaled readiness to write data (WRITE_BUF_RDY) before the command completed (CMD_END), leading to data CRC errors and failed write operations. Additionally, the alcor_trigger_data_transfer() function was being called multiple times during each write operation, which added further confusion and contributed to this issue.
